title: Proteus Player Manifest (v0)
description: The genome and its bounds. A player IS this object: content-addressed (organism_id = sha256 of canonical JSON), interpreted by the frozen runtime, never host code. Every field is a bounded integer, a boolean, or an enum; no field carries a string a player can read. Bounds are the published affordance table's STORAGE_BOUNDS and are enforced fail-closed by proteus.foundry.vm.validate_manifest, which is the authority when this document and the code disagree.

n_regs.description: register count; operand fields are taken modulo this

tape_words.description: bounded storage; the genome occupies the front of the tape

genome.description: 32-bit words, length a multiple of 4 and <= tape_words; instruction = (op, a, b, c); op = word mod 25

code_writable.description: if false, ST into the genome region is ignored (protected/stable state); if true the program may rewrite itself

persist.description: what survives a tick boundary: nothing, registers, tape, or both

tick_budget.description: maximum operations per tick; a caller may lower it, never raise it

out_cap.description: maximum values appended per output channel per tick; further appends are dropped and counted
